verdict.rationale: The docs establish modularity: apps are built from declarative components with scoped CSS, and .svelte.js/.svelte.ts files hold reusable reactive logic and shared state. Dependency injection is supported only by a community mention that 'Svelte Stores and the Context system are especially great for sharing state'. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the Context API as a dependency-injection mechanism (providing and consuming dependencies through the component tree), docs on injecting services or stores into components, and independent hands-on corroboration of DI patterns.
